title: Star detectors overflow unchecked radius scratch-buffer arithmetic
summary: Radius 32768 produces signed overflow 65537 * 65537 in precise and fast scratch allocations under UBSan. Precise now fails even on a constant empty image after allocation hoisting in 21d2af5c5; previous precise returns zero stars. Validate radius/geometry and checked allocation arithmetic, preserving radius 0.
